description: Create the FastAPI application skeleton (backend/app) with: /health endpoint returning service status/version; pydantic settings loaded from environment (APP port/prefix); unittest-discoverCompatible pytest suite (unittest.TestCase style, runnable by both pytest and python -m unittest discover) for /health asserting 200 OK and version field; no external calls; pinned dependencies recorded in backend/pyproject.toml.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns 200 with JSON containing status and version fields

Test suite for /health passes locally in unittest-discover form (python -m unittest discover -s tests -v from backend/) and is also runnable via pytest; pure pytest-only styles that unittest discovery would skip silently are not accepted
No AWS/network calls from the health endpoint or its tests
Python package layout with pinned dependencies in backend/pyproject.toml and README development section with run instructions
Tests import the app via explicit sys.path insertion of the backend directory so they pass under the deterministic checker's sanitized environment

planning.title: FastAPI backend skeleton with /health and tests
